title: W as a signature surface
slide_intent: Treat the identity as a place for participation because a museum’s voice includes artists as well as the institution.
strategic_value: The blank and written-on W can express Whitney as a platform on which others leave a mark.
demonstration: Two cyan Ws carry Whitney at the upper left; the right example adds black handwritten words along the diagonal strokes.
practical_value: Compare an unoccupied structural mark with one activated by handwriting, while keeping this colored preliminary sketch separate from final color guidance.

content_islands.name: Empty structure
content_islands.spec: Place the cyan W and Whitney name at left.

content_islands.name: Activated structure
content_islands.spec: Repeat the form at right and add black writing along its diagonals.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay describes the W as a blank canvas for an artist’s signature.
reference_purposes.Expression: The preliminary pair contrasts a clean line structure with handwritten marks.
